title: 육군학생군사학교령 / queue:ADDENDUM:28266:20170905:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Decree of the Military Personnel Management Act) <Presidential Decree No. 28266, September 5, 2017>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted.>

Articles 2 and 3
Omitted.

Article 4 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) through (70) Omitted.

(71) The Decree on the Army Cadet Military School shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 2 (2), "장관급" (the former Korean term for general-officer rank) shall be replaced with "장성급(將星級)" (general-officer rank), and in paragraph (4) of the same Article, "장관급" shall be replaced with "장성급".

(72) through (90) Omitted.
